Aisha (CS): FYI — OPAL QBR scheduled for next Wed. Need a short readout on token econ, forecasted burn, and onboarding gaps. They hit high embed volume during pilot. Can we pull numbers + any immediate guardrails?
Devon (CSE): On it. Do we have the recent 7d embedding breakdown and the onboarding timeline?
Sam (FinOps): I can run a tail forecast. Quick ask: what SLA tier are they on for Dedicated? that affects reserved vs variable split.
Aisha (CS): They're on standard Dedicated (monthly commit) but still using hosted for some feature flags. Onboarding ETA mid-May.
Lucas (Solutions): Also collecting feedback from their PM — they said images->text workflows spiked token usage after the preview release. Could be classifier calls.
Devon (CSE): Copy. Pulling usage now. Expect numbers in ~30m.
budget-bot: ALERT: account/opal crossed 75% of monthly token commit at 2023-11-02T14:23:12Z (:warning:). Threshold rules applied.
Sam (FinOps): Raw forecast quick pass:
```
Current commit: 1.2M tokens/month
Usage last 7d: 430k tokens
7d avg/day: ~61k
Extrapolated month: ~1.83M tokens
Projected over-commit: ~630k tokens (~52% over)
```
Sam (FinOps): That's without accounting for the preview spike. If embed-heavy features roll to 50% of users, we could see 2.6–3.0M tokens.
Aisha (CS): Oof. Need remediation options for the QBR slides. Top of mind: throttle preview, set embed sampling, or recommend quantization + batch config via Optimize.
Lucas (Solutions): Recommend two deliverables for QBR: 1) short-term guardrails (sampling, per-route caps) 2) medium-term cost plan (batching + quantization + Dedicated sizing). I can draft runbook.
Devon (CSE): I can add model/route-level configs and quick toggles. For the meeting we should present current SLO impact and a 30/60/90 plan.
Sam (FinOps): I'll prepare a 90-day spend scenario table with conservative/likely/aggressive columns. Want me to include per-token unit economics and suggested commit delta?
Aisha (CS): Yes — include recommended commit bump for 3 options and the cost delta. Also capture renewal risk: if we remain way over commit, they may push for lower commit or pause.
Lucas (Solutions): I'll collect a short feature-impact blurb from PM so QBR has customer voice.
Devon (CSE): Quick ask — does anyone have the embed model ID they used? need to check if a cheaper quantized variant exists.
Aisha (CS): PM said they're using open-embed-1024-v1. Lucas/Devon please confirm compat with quantized option.
Sam (FinOps): Timeline: I'll drop a preliminary forecast by EOD, final by tomorrow noon.
Aisha (CS): Thanks team. Action items pinned: Sam: forecast + cost delta; Devon: route toggles + model variant check; Lucas: runbook + customer quote; I'll draft QBR slide skeleton.
Devon (CSE): Roger. Posting quick snippet of the 7d top routes now.
Aisha (CS): Great — we'll sync at 10am standup and finalize slides by 3pm for internal review. :thumbsup:
